chapters.label: The volley, live
chapters.text: Madrid, 2024. Real Madrid are losing to Manchester City. Luka Modrić finds Vinícius, and he floats a cross over the box... Fede Valverde hits it first time. What a volley! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Eyes on the ball. He swings his right leg, ankle locked, toes pointing down... and hits the middle of the ball.

chapters.label: Into the corner
chapters.text: Behind the goal: low and hard, it flies into the corner. The keeper can't reach it. Three all!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: lock your ankle and strike through the middle of the ball.
